user.title: Plant Manager
user.description: Set up Plant Manager. Your plants are stored in the `plant_manager` folder of your configuration directory. Add them in the **Plants** panel; set up photo identification under **Configure**.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Plant Manager is already set up.

identification.title: Plant identification and care data
identification.description: Pl@ntNet is free (500 identifications a day, key from my.plantnet.org). OpenPlantbook (open.plantbook.io, free) adds measured temperature, humidity, soil moisture and light ranges per species. An AI Task entity can identify plants and estimates care profiles for species that are not in the built-in database.

data_description.ai_task_entity: Leave empty to use your default AI Task entity. Used for AI identification and care profiles of unknown species.

data_description.notify_alerts: Notifications for plants that need water or fertilizer, and for problems (too cold, too dark, ...).
data_description.notify_service: A phone with the Home Assistant app (or another notify action) for everyone: problems right away, and a daily summary of what to water and fertilize. Each person can also choose their own phones and time with the 🔔 button in the Plants panel.
data_description.reminder_time: When the daily summary is sent.
data_description.weather_entity: Outdoor plants without their own sensors use its temperature and humidity; rain counts as watering for uncovered plants.

error.api_key_required: This provider needs an API key.
error.openplantbook_incomplete: Enter both the OpenPlantbook client ID and secret, or neither.
error.notify_not_found: This notify action does not exist.

options.none: Nothing, I choose the species myself

options.too_dry: Soil was too dry: remind me earlier
options.too_wet: Soil was still wet: remind me later

plant_id.name: Plants
plant_id.description: Plant IDs (shown in the plant's dialog in the panel).

at.name: When
at.description: When they were watered. Defaults to now.

feedback.name: Soil before watering
feedback.description: How dry the soil was. Tunes future reminders for the plant.

snooze.name: Soil still moist
snooze.description: Postpones the watering reminder and learns a slightly longer interval.

log_care.name: Log care
log_care.description: Adds an entry to the care log: fertilized, repotted, pruned, misted, or a note.

send_reminder.name: Send reminder
send_reminder.description: Sends today's care summary to the notify action now.

identify.name: Identify plant
identify.description: Identifies a plant from a camera snapshot or an image file and returns candidate species.

camera_entity_id.name: Camera
camera_entity_id.description: Camera to take a snapshot from.

image_path.name: Image path
image_path.description: Path to an image in an allowlisted directory.

set_vacation.name: Plan vacation
set_vacation.description: Plans a vacation (or changes the planned one): what to water before leaving, and when a plant sitter has to come.

start_date.name: Leaving
start_date.description: The day you leave (in the morning).

end_date.name: Back
end_date.description: The day you are back (in the evening).

sitter.name: Plant sitter
sitter.description: Who waters while you are away.

sitter_notify.name: Sitter's notify action
sitter_notify.description: Sends the plant sitter a reminder on each day they need to come, e.g. notify.mobile_app_anna.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: Added to the plan for the sitter (where the key is, the watering can, ...).

end_vacation.name: End vacation
end_vacation.description: Back early: ends the vacation that is going on, or cancels the planned one.

path_not_allowed.message: Access to {path} is not allowed. Add its folder to allowlist_external_dirs.
